name: go-gin-url-shortener
title: Kısa.link – URL Shortener
description: A Go/Gin URL shortener with click statistics, a JSON API and an HTTP Basic Auth protected admin panel, persisted in a pure-Go SQLite database and compiled into a single static binary.

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: Public base URL used to build short links (set to the deployed origin, no trailing slash)

env.name: ADMIN_PASS
env.description: HTTP Basic Auth password for /admin (demo value; override in real deployments)

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: SQLite database file path; directory is created if missing (Docker image sets /data/kisa.db)

env.name: GIN_MODE
env.description: Gin mode: debug | release | test (Docker image sets release)

auth.description: Public shortening, redirect, stats and JSON API. The /admin area is protected by HTTP Basic Auth (gin.BasicAuth) with credentials from ADMIN_USER / ADMIN_PASS; unauthenticated requests get 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header.

persistence: sqlite file at data/kisa.db (WAL mode; /data/kisa.db inside the container) – schema migrated and 5 demo links seeded on first start
notes: Single static binary, no CGO needed. go.mod requires go >= 1.25 (Go toolchains >= 1.21 auto-download it). Container runs as uid 65532 (distroless nonroot): a named volume mounted at /data works out of the box, but a host bind-mount directory must be writable by uid 65532 (chown 65532:65532 ./data). Set BASE_URL to the externally visible origin so generated short links are correct.
